summary: Update device labels by exporting the device with `flightctl get device/<name> -o yaml > my_device.yaml`, editing metadata.labels, and applying it with `flightctl apply -f my_device.yaml`.
questions: How do I change labels on an edge device with the CLI?
How do I edit and reapply a device definition in flightctl?
Does flightctl apply update device labels?

answer_card.title: Update device labels with flightctl
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
flightctl get device/<device> -o yaml > my_device.yaml
# edit metadata.labels:
#   some_key: some_value
flightctl apply -f my_device.yaml
flightctl get devices -o wide   # verify LABELS column
```
